node.statement: For X in S_{R,T}, def-compressed-corner gives X=R(XT)+O(e)||X|| and Co_{R_i,T}X=R_i(XT)+O(e)||X||. Since R_0+R_1=R exactly, Co_{R_0,T}X+Co_{R_1,T}X=X+O(e)||X||. Applying the uniformly bounded Co_{R,T} and using Co_{R,T}X=X exactly gives ||ABX-X||<=C_2 e||X||, hence ||AB-I||<=C_2 e with universal C_2.
